mapper.sql: id, owner_user_id, scene, bucket_name, object_key, original_filename, file_ext, content_type, file_size, sha256, status, deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_object (owner_user_id, scene, bucket_name, object_key, original_filename, file_ext, content_type, file_size, sha256, status, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{ownerUserId}, #{scene}, #{bucketName}, #{objectKey}, #{originalFilename}, #{fileExt}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{sha256}, #{status}, 0, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM file_object WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM file_object WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM file_object WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND sha256 = #{sha256} AND status = 'READY' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE file_object SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
